assumptions: CLI route `--metric psnrhvs` -> psnrhvs_rgb8 (lib.rs:369-378) -> deinterleave u8->3x f32 planes per image (lib.rs:381-430) then plane_step_impl(step=8) per channel via join2 (lib.rs:431-455); score = mean of 3 channel scores.
Per-channel kernel is IDENTICAL to psnrhvs-y (8x8 DCT-II, masking, coef error, fold): stages below are psnrhvs-y's per-channel work x3 channels; block count NB same per channel.
psnrhvsm masked variant emits from the same run (byproduct, no extra work).
Step=8 non-overlapping blocks; NB = floor((W-8)/8+1)*floor((H-8)/8+1) per channel.

stages.name: RGB8 -> 3 planar f32 per image
stages.notes: deinterleave_u8_ch x3 channels x2 images; plain u8->f32 cvt (no luma weights).

stages.name: separable f32 DCT-II 8x8, both blocks
stages.notes: Per block: 2 imgs x (64 fma row pass + 64 fma... ) = 2x1024 fma. Block loads 64 px each img. Runs per channel (join2 parallel); elements x3.

stages.name: masking threshold e/pop/variance -> block mask
stages.notes: Per image-block: e sum 63mul+63add, var 64add+div+64(sub+fma=2ops)+div+mul, 4 quads x ~50, fold ~10 -> ~600 add-equiv + 135 mul + 7 div + sqrt. x2 images.

stages.name: masked/unmasked coefficient energy sums
stages.notes: Per coef (64): |da-db| (add+abs), t2=u*cv mul + acc add; c>=1: thr=mask/mv div, max cmp, t1 mul + acc.

stages.name: f64 fold + 10*log10 finalize
stages.notes: Per block: 2 cvt + 2 f64 adds (maps skipped). Finalize once: ~10 flops + log10.
